$comment: Check of each Cosmos sentence in eval.json against the gold facts of contracts/fixtures/uc/videos.json and the 1 fps frame sheets docs/evidence/uc/frames/. Written by hand, never by Astra. `sentences` lists the exact sentence each check was made on; a sentence not listed is unchecked. facts_match: the target, the destination, the order and completion agree with the video (minor position details noted but not counted). astra_faithful: the plan says what the sentence says (a wrong sentence can still be followed faithfully).
checked_by: Claude Code (frames + gold), confirmed by the user on 2026-09-29
